action.rationale: The named answers assemble the D10 memorandum. DEFINITIONS: sorted quadruples 1<=a<=b<=c<=d with a^2+b^2+c^2+d^2=4abcd, Vieta mutation with re-sorting, height = max coordinate d, root (1,1,1,1), N(H) counts vertices with d<=H (restated from SC1-SC6, C3, C6 in each answer). PROVED: (D1) connectivity of every solution to (1,1,1,1) by strict integer height descent via d'=4abc-d; (D2) uniqueness of the height-decreasing mutation at every non-root, with the equal-coordinate subtlety resolved at the vertex level; (D3) the quotient mutation graph is a rooted tree (cycle/multiple-parent exclusion from D2 plus the no-height-preserving-mutation corollary) — answer:work:003-struct-core-v2. (D4) N(H) <= C*H^rho + O(log H) with rho = ln3/ln11 = 0.4582 and effective C <= 0.372, via the proved slow/fast dichotomy (the a=b=1 locus is a single chain with ratio -> 2+sqrt(3); ab is nondecreasing along child edges; off-chain subtrees rooted at u_j have per-edge factor >= 11 and m_j >= 121*(11/3)^{j-2}, making the subtree sum convergent); (D6) two-sided depth relation log_3(log_2 d + 1) <= depth(v) <= log_3 d, with the chain the unique slowest branch at depth log_{2+sqrt3}(d)+O(1) — answer:work:004-upper-depth-v3. (D5) N(H) >= max{floor(log_{2+sqrt3} H)+1, c'(log_2 H)^{0.6309}} for H>=32 (chain lemma L1, two-children-below-depth-2 lemma L2, binary-subtree lemma L3; the first, Theta(log H), term is dominant) — answer:work:006-lower-bound-v5-compact. SANITY CHECKS AND FAILURE MODES (D7/D9): labeled hand-checkable observations O1-O3 ((1,1,1,3), (1,1,3,11), (1,3,11,131) with parent-edge values d'=1,1,1 and one-line substitutions); two recorded induction/proof failure modes that were caught and corrected (the false mod-3 obstruction route; the false d_j >= 11(2+sqrt3)^{j-2} skeleton inequality); one corrected false dominance clause in the lower-bound packet. REPORTED OBSTRUCTION: the bounded d<=100 cross-checking enumeration (fully specified, reproducible procedure frozen in question:work:005-exception-search-v4) never executed — three attempts all failed on output-length overruns (blocked, zero-evidence answers answer:work:005-exception-search-v4 and predecessors), so empirical corroboration is limited to the labeled spot checks; this is an execution gap, not a mathematical one, since D1-D3 are proved unconditionally. CONJECTURES, STRICTLY SEPARATED (D8): (i) exponent sharpness — is rho = ln3/ln11 improvable toward the true growth, e.g. via the sketched-but-unexecuted iterated product-jump dichotomy (product-raising children jump p -> >= p^{3/2}, potentially yielding N(H) = O_eps(H^eps)) — open as question:raised:07d805ce56d7:rq-sharp; (ii) lower side beyond Theta(log H) — requires a positive-density two-child branching lemma with average log-growth slope strictly below 3 — open as question:raised:529a9c7e8677:rq-d5-stronger. No growth law is assumed anywhere; the proved bracket is c*log H <= N(H) <= C*H^{0.4582} + O(log H). MOST INFORMATIVE NEXT MATHEMATICAL STEP: quantify typical branching and typical per-edge factor inside one fast subtree subtree(u_j) (rq-sharp), or equivalently prove the positive-density branching lemma on the lower side (rq-d5-stronger); a cheap auxiliary step is hand-executing the frozen d<=100 enumeration spec. Acceptance is met as honest partial progress with complete proofs of the structural claims and explicit, effective quantitative bounds, per the dossier's stated standard.
